How We Work

Five clear steps from gap audit to daily habit.

Every engagement is structured around your production schedule, your workforce, and the highest-impact operational priorities.

STEP 01 Understand Walk the floor, map current process flows, and align on business & regulatory goals.
STEP 02 Assess Conduct a clause-by-clause & line-by-line gap assessment with photo evidence.
STEP 03 Design Build practical layouts, hazard analyses, SOPs, and prioritized CAPA action plans.
STEP 04 Enable Train QA teams, supervisors, and operators on the floor until records run smoothly.
STEP 05 Verify Run mock audits, verify metrics, and support you through certification or buyer inspections.

Common Questions

Frequently asked questions.

Do you help with new (Greenfield) food or dairy plant layout before construction?
Yes. Reviewing your layout before civil work begins is the single best way to avoid costly demolition later. We align your architect's CAD drawings with FSSAI Schedule 4 and ISO 22000 unidirectional man-and-material flow, hygienic zoning, drainage, air handling, and utility routing.
How long does it take to prepare a facility for FSSAI Schedule 4, HACCP, or ISO 22000 certification?
Depending on plant size and current maturity, FSSAI Schedule 4 and HACCP readiness typically takes 4 to 8 weeks. Full ISO 22000 or FSSC 22000 implementation—including hazard analysis, SOP rollout, floor training, internal audit, and management review—typically takes 8 to 14 weeks.
Can your team train shop-floor operators in Marathi and Hindi?
Absolutely. Documentation that stays in a QA cabin does not prevent contamination. We conduct practical shop-floor hygiene, personal sanitation, allergen, and CCP monitoring sessions in Marathi, Hindi, and English so operators understand both the "how" and the "why."
We are a growing MSME food business—do we need a full-time retainer or project-based support?
We offer both. You can start with a focused 1-to-2 day Diagnostic Gap Audit or a fixed-scope project (such as Plant Layout Design or ISO 22000 Certification Readiness), and optionally transition to a monthly quality & audit retainer as your production scales.
